selectionStatus: The current product candidate uses automatic stage routing: Fluid SenseVoice int8 for live drafts and sentence-level Chinese-English mixing, Fluid Paraformer int8 for clearly Mandarin final recomputation, and Fluid Parakeet Unified int8 for clearly English final recomputation. The two monolingual final candidates passed their pinned public FLEURS real-human tuning profiles; SenseVoice failed the combined realistic profile and therefore is not treated as the all-language final default. This tuning selection is not release eligibility. Fluid offline diarization remains the frozen speaker candidate after the independent public AMI holdout, and Qwen3 1.7B MLX plus deterministic editing remains the protected local-text candidate. Every runtime loads only model-manager-verified local files.
